cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put your gnome back by the pond. I've brought him home in a box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does he need a box?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: His head and body are packed separately. I'll glue them before you have to look.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's Dad's gnome. Don't replace any part of him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll use the broken pieces, then. One ear's missing; help me look in the box before I start.

reason: Give B an explicit inherited attachment and a repair boundary; A yields control of gluing and reveals the missing ear while recruiting a joint search.
